value.rationale: A natural and practically motivated endpoint positivity problem for every finite tree is solved exactly in linear-time local graph data, distinguishing the competing edge and three-step failure mechanisms with sharp witnesses. It subsumes restricted network motifs while proving a universal nonreentrance principle not implied by earlier special-family classifications.
